patterns.note: Asymmetrical, editorial-style layouts featuring large, impactful imagery and text blocks, often with significant negative space and a mix of full-width and contained content.
Dramatic contrast between oversized, elegant serif display typography for headings and decorative elements, and clean, legible sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
High-contrast color scheme alternating between light beige and deep charcoal/black sections, creating distinct visual breaks and emphasizing content.
The navigation bar transforms from a transparent state to a solid dark background and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Sections are often introduced with large, decorative single letters (e.g., 'R', 'W') that act as visual anchors and break up content flow, appearing as static, oversized background elements.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion, use CSS keyframes or transitions to animate the navigation bar's background color and position (from static to fixed/sticky) upon scroll, triggered when the user scrolls past a certain viewport threshold. Sections can be revealed with a simple scroll-triggered fade-in or slide-up effect using CSS keyframes.

Achieve the distinctive typography by pairing a highly stylized, large serif font for display purposes and decorative elements with a modern, readable sans-serif for all other text. Ensure generous line-height and letter-spacing for the display text to maintain elegance.

Implement the high-contrast section design by alternating full-width content blocks with distinct background colors (light beige and dark charcoal), ensuring text color provides sufficient contrast on each background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-5x body) are paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text, creating a strong visual hierarchy and editorial feel.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — particularly in hero and section introductions, with generous padding and negative space around key elements.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, oversized serif typography used both as decorative elements and prominent section titles, creating a strong editorial and luxurious feel. This, combined with the high-contrast, alternating light and dark sections, gives the site a unique visual rhythm that elevates it beyond typical modern templates.
